home.title: Practise test automation on the parts of the web that make it hard
home.intro: Each scenario is a small page built around something that trips up automated tests: dialogs drawn by the browser, elements inside iframes and shadow roots, content that loads late or moves, drag and drop, files, clocks and much more. Use whichever tool you like, such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or WebdriverIO, against this site.

steps.choose: Pick a scenario below. Its card says what it covers and how hard it is to automate.
steps.read: Read its description and information, which explain what to test and the traps to look out for.
steps.test: Point your tests at the scenario's page. Each one has its own address, so a test can open it directly.

home.source-link: suggest or add a scenario on GitHub
